candidates.edits: A initial active launch CX 9->7, B initial launch CX 8->7; both worker CL 9->7. Private REP copy stays 9 words. No byte-length or fixed-offset changes.
candidates.hypothesis: Bootstrap MOVSB plus MOVSW plus 7 REP MOVSW iterations copies exactly the 17-byte worker; removing all excess recurring copying saves two REP turns per relocation.
candidates.failure_modes: Exact-length copying leaves no spare trailing bytes. Corruption in the last far-call operand or timing interactions can negate the nominal speed gain. Requires official-engine smoke and paired scoring.
